donate_btc:
Donations: Bitcoin

create_note: Creates a BitTorrent v1 .torrent locally (like transmission-create). For seeding, keep the data under i2pd’s torrentsdir with matching paths.
create_need_source: Choose an existing file or folder
search_placeholder: Search by name or info hash
files_note: The file list comes from torrent metadata, so it is available before the download finishes. Skip and priority need torrent-set; current i2pd only reports the list (wanted/priorities are placeholders).
files_set_unsupported: This i2pd build does not accept torrent-set yet. Skip and priority will work after the daemon adds it.
files_empty: This torrent has no file list yet. Update i2pd (openssl branch, 20 Aug 2026 or newer).
peers_note: Double-click an ident hash to copy it.
trackers_note: Announce URLs from the i2pd torrents tunnel (RPC trackers field).
settings_note: This is not transmission-remote: the GUI talks to i2pd’s built-in RPC. Set rpcport, rpcpath, and torrentsdir in i2pd’s tunnels.conf — RPC address and folder here are read-only from that file. The address is completed with /rpc/ automatically.
settings_rpc_tip: Read-only from rpcport and rpcpath in i2pd’s tunnels.conf. Edit that file and restart i2pd.
settings_dir_tip: Path from torrentsdir in i2pd’s tunnels.conf. Browse opens the folder; edit the path only in that config.
settings_open_dir_missing: Torrents folder is empty or does not exist. Set torrentsdir in i2pd’s tunnels.conf and restart i2pd.
rpc_url_local_only: i2pd RPC has no authentication: only a local address is allowed
rpc_redirect: i2pd RPC must not redirect requests
rpc_setup_tip:
The GUI connects to i2pd’s built-in torrent RPC.
transmission-remote is not required — this client already speaks Transmission RPC.

Connection refused means nothing is listening at the RPC address.
i2pd 2.61.0 does not start RPC yet: you need a newer daemon (openssl branch)
and a section in tunnels.conf:

[MyTorrents]
type=torrents
trackers=http://tracker2.postman.i2p/announce.php
torrentsdir=/path/to/torrents
rpcport=9191
rpcpath=mytorrents

Restart i2pd after editing. In Settings use:
http://127.0.0.1:9191/mytorrents
